messages:
rev: quick pass on the Quickstart found a couple of small UX inconsistencies that confuse first-time devs: mixed auth env names, a TypeScript snippet using `any`, and a dead deploy link. creating a thread to batch fixes.

peggy: thanks, can you paste the exact TS snippet + the broken link?

rev: TS snippet excerpt:```ts
// current
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client: any = new Redwood(process.env.RW_KEY)
await client.generate('hello')
```
broken link -> https://docs.redwood.ai/deploy/checklist (404).

omar: i'll take the TS snippet + standardize to chat.create and proper typing. will change RW_KEY -> RW_API_KEY. proposed:```ts
import Redwood, { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client: RedwoodClient = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
const res = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood/fast', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }] })
console.log(res.output)
```

kia: i'll grep for RW_KEY / REDWOOD_KEY and update cases in docs and starter examples; i'll also replace the broken link with /quickstart/deploy and add a short migration note at the top: "Upgrading from older examples". opening a single PR with all changes.

doc-bot: created issue #537: "quickstart: ts typing, auth env rename, deploy link" assigned to omar and kia.

omar: PR #3467 opened with TS snippet and a tiny copy tweak explaining RW_API_KEY usage in CI/secrets. left one question for peggy about wording.

peggy: nit on wording: prefer "store the key in your CI secrets or a secrets manager" instead of "CI/secrets". pushed small suggestion.

kia: PR #3468 opened: repo sweep for RW_KEY/REDWOOD_KEY -> RW_API_KEY, updated starter-app links, and swapped the deploy link to /quickstart/deploy. included link-check and mdlint.

doc-bot: PR #3467 and #3468 checks started.

site-bot: PR #3467 passed checks. PR #3468 link-check flagged one remaining absolute URL in legacy-starters/README.md. kia fixing.

kia: fixed stray URL in #3468 and pushed.

site-bot: all checks passed. PRs merged by omar and kia. Docs deploy queued.

omar: quick smoke on staging once deployed would be great so we can confirm the updated TS snippet renders correctly.

site-bot: docs deploy succeeded. staging: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart (staging).

rev: verified staging: TS example updated + types look good, RW_API_KEY used across examples, deploy link resolves. thanks team — closing thread. :white_check_mark:
